name: Strider, Ranger of the North — a 3/3 target reaches power 4 through the +1/+1 and gains first strike
notes: "target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then if that creature has power 4 or greater, it gains first strike until end of turn." (2026-10-07) The "Then if" sentence is its own conditional line sharing the one target; the power test reads the target as the ability resolved (fire-time state plus this ability's own +1/+1), not the live value in layer 6. Hill Giant 3/3: 4/4 with first strike. Craw Wurm, not the target, has neither.
